Scheduled tasks run with your default sandbox settings, which are currently set to Full Access. Running scheduled tasks in the background with Full Access carries elevated risk, as ChatGPT may modify files, run commands, and access network without asking. Consider updating sandbox settings to workspace write, and using <rulesDocsLink>rules</rulesDocsLink> to selectively define which commands the agent can run with full access.

Scheduled tasks use your configured sandbox settings. Projectless tasks can write files in their generated workspace, and their network access follows your configured setting. They run without approval prompts unless your organization requires them. You can selectively allowlist commands to run outside the sandbox using <rulesDocsLink>rules</rulesDocsLink>.

Scheduled tasks run with your default sandbox settings, which are set to read-only. Tool calls will fail if they require modifying files, accessing network, or working with apps on your computer. Consider updating sandbox settings to workspace write.
